policy: Every 'verified' entry names a real, currently-passing test file and command in this repository. Browser checks now run locally (Playwright + Chromium via the system proxy), so they are implemented and verified rather than blocked.
browser_blocker: resolved — pnpm install @playwright/test initially failed with ETIMEDOUT because Node.js did not inherit the Windows system proxy; setting HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY to http://127.0.0.1:7897 and forcing --proxy-server=direct:// in playwright.config.cjs enabled Chromium and the browser suite.

requirements.note: E2E qualification regression kept; the 371/93 frozen replay is unavailable so it stays unverified (not substituted with the 66-batch freeze).
Trusted PR association recovery, in-place recovery with migration records and propagated source failures.
Whole-batch deletion attack is rejected by the pre-publish gate.
Coverage categories and closure kept; Triton full-source enumeration, derived-sampling-not-full-pass and PR #2513-unverified are pinned.
Counting ledger separates raw/unique/public/out-of-window/other; 887/885 gap stays honest unverified.

The public duration renderer is the single tested Units module: app.js minute delegates to Units.minutesValue (real zero '0.00', sub-0.01-min '<0.01', unknown/negative '—', 21.68-day extreme retained); detail/export keep exact ms/s. Time/status/quality/eligibility axes stay independent (result dots vs issues vs eligible); Triton observed/as-of and approximate origins are labelled; the quality page links to the same-entity detail and missing-start records stay queryable.
Per-PR longest representative batch and merged cross-repo P90 kept.
JSON/CSV/qualification/fingerprint consistency kept; UDR-026/029 accept the public bundle.

Public workbench attention is now wired: Shell.buildWorkbenchConcerns extracts UBS failure/issue/collection errors (repository-qualified stable batch identity) and Triton failure/running/unknown-PR/P90-slow concerns, Shell.concernRows merges reasons into one row per batch, same-number PRs/batches in different repositories stay separate, unknown PR is an independent source identity, and a later in-snapshot success marks without erasing the historical failure.
Route entry and mutually exclusive main views kept.
Workbench expresses only real known status.
Detail/chart resource lifecycle kept.
Full-read timeout/concurrency/failure preservation kept (cache-chain fails only on Windows/WSL environment).
Narrow-screen fields and keyboard paths kept.
Catalog-driven fixed-task side-nav replaces per-community menus; project selector re-scopes task links and isolates per-project conditions; unsupported tasks explain the reason.
S/L search isolation kept; explicit advanced filter entry reveals trigger/quality, shows a persistent condition bar with effective denominator, and clears back to the full set.

列表/图表/关注三入口统一详情骨架全线落地并浏览器验证：UBS 列表/图表/关注收敛于共享 #detail 弹窗（PR→全部已采集批次→任务→来源证据，代表批次默认/选中批次展开/无代表解释、证据/版本行、关闭返回上下文）；Triton 记录列表、E2E 图表散点（点击或 Enter）与关注行现都进入同一 #detail 弹窗，保留 workflow/attempt 结构与来源证据（unified-detail.spec.cjs + dashboard.spec.cjs）。NPU 排队图表展示的是排队时长这一独立度量（其专用预览卡），不属于本项 workflow/attempt 详情骨架。

两项目共享公共记录任务：UBS Records.ubsBatchRecords（批次/PR 切换）与 Triton Records.tritonBatchRecords（仅批次，不伪造 PR E2E）共用同一稳定先排序后分页模型，未知值恒列末位、合法零保留、稳定身份并列决胜，双社区浏览器验证（unified-records.spec.cjs）。未知身份 Triton 记录保留且可查看；记录行、图表散点、关注行的详情关闭/后退均返回保存位置（unified-detail.spec.cjs + dashboard.spec.cjs）。

All five versioned scopes wired (S summary / L records / deduplicated concerns / PR all-batches / selected-batch tasks): on-screen summary declares entity/scope/count/unit/profile+snapshot version, version bound at click time, dedupe collapses duplicate reasons by batch identity, CSV comment-free and untruncated by pagination, failure shows a retry button that re-runs the same export. Legal-empty metadata (0 rows, header only) is covered at the model level.

Full records/quality URL context round-trips: q/entity/repository/branch/from/to/basis plus sort/tm/state/tf/qf/ps/page, and the detail identity (pr). A shared URL restores the same controls/list/detail; input replaces while confirmed changes push; an out-of-window time/branch or an unknown pr explains and falls back to the current snapshot/list without substituting another entity.
Real adapter protocol and validation propagation kept; the unified collect CLI exits non-zero on honest failures and zero on legal empty success.
Project artifact isolation and trusted load kept; full attack matrix (duplicate, stale attempt, unknown/disabled project, hash/missing/escape, ownership) pinned.
